mapper.select: SELECT id, ST_X(geom) AS lon, ST_Y(geom) AS lat FROM real_estate_sales
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_score (property_id, transit_base, education_base, commerce_base, convenience_base, computed_at) VALUES (#{propertyId}, #{transitBase}, #{educationBase}, #{commerceBase}, #{convenienceBase}, now()) ON CONFLICT (property_id) DO UPDATE SET transit_base = EXCLUDED.transit_base, education_base = EXCLUDED.education_base, commerce_base = EXCLUDED.commerce_base, convenience_base = EXCLUDED.convenience_base, computed_at = now()
